RebelFunnels.DocArchive: Funnels are archived by Matomo's normal archiving. These commands archive them right away:
RebelFunnels.DocArchiveTitle: Archiving funnels from the command line
RebelFunnels.DocCounting: A funnel is a list of steps in order. A visit enters at the first step, and reaches a step only after the step before it, in the same visit. Other pages and actions in between are fine. For each step you see how many visits reached it, how many went on, how many left there and how long it took on average to get to the next step.
RebelFunnels.DocDirect: A step can be set to count only when it is the very next action of the visit after the step before. An event between two pages then breaks it.
RebelFunnels.DocGoals: A rule can also be "Goal converted": the step is reached when the visit converts a goal of the website, places an ecommerce order or abandons a cart. The funnel then also shows the revenue of those conversions. A funnel for all websites can use orders and carts, but no goals.
RebelFunnels.DocLimits: A funnel can have at most %s steps. A super user changes that under Administration > System > General settings, in the RebelFunnels section.
RebelFunnels.DocManage: Pausing a funnel keeps its data but archives nothing new; resuming it builds the time in between. Duplicating copies a funnel, also to another website. A funnel with a goal as a step can only be copied to a website that has a goal with the same ID.
RebelFunnels.DocNext: Click the number of visits that left at a step to see what they did next: the page, event, download, outlink or search that followed, or that they left the website.
RebelFunnels.DocRebuild: Funnels are counted when Matomo archives, from the data it already has. A new funnel, or one whose rules, order rule or segment changed, is built for the last %s months the next time archiving runs. Until then the list and the funnel tell how many days are waiting. Changing names builds nothing again.
RebelFunnels.DocRules: A step is reached by an action that matches any of its rules. A rule compares the page URL, page title, event category, action or name, download URL, outlink URL or site search keyword with a value: is exactly, contains, starts with, ends with, or a regular expression. Upper and lower case make no difference, and URLs are compared without "https://" and "www.". The editor tells which steps a URL you paste matches.
RebelFunnels.DocSegment: A funnel can be restricted to a segment in the editor, such as visits from one country. Funnels also work with the segments and the comparisons of Matomo.
